text: Cute little floating island with a tomato patch and a bunny-ish character. Says 'Tap the ripe crop'. Day 2, 10 coins. Let me tap the tomatoes.
Oops, I seem to have tapped the bunny (Momo) instead of the farm -- a panel with 'Assign' popped up. Prompt still says tap the farm. Trying the left side of the bed.
Watered. Night fell fast -- a day seems to be 30 seconds. Now it says 'Tap a Momo' with the bunny highlighted. Tapping it.
Pencil mode: 'Tap tiles or drag across them 0/4'. I guess Momo can look after up to 4 tiles. The farm is the only thing here, so I'll tap the farm tile.
Momo now works the farm on her own -- coins went 13 -> 19, income +9/min. Nice idle feel. Mailbox has a red dot and an envelope bubble floats over the farm. Checking mail.
Lovely letter from Momo proposing a 'Field expansion' research. Charming. Income is climbing (+15/min). Pressing 'Let's research it'.
Research tree! Tabs: Farm, Lumber, Mine, Smelting, Power, Games... big game ahead. Field expansion costs 3 flasks + 20 coins, and I need a research lab first. Tapping 'Build a research lab'.
Build menu opened. Research lab opens at Lv2 (I'm Lv1, 49/95 xp). Farm costs 10 and I have 40. Building a second farm while I level up.
Farm got placed automatically on the east tile and is building (2 s). I didn't choose where -- fine for now. New mail again.

Accepted the watering-efficiency proposal too. Momo walked over to the new farm by herself and is harvesting it -- I didn't have to assign it. XP 92/95, about to hit Lv2 which unlocks the research lab. Waiting a moment.
Level 2! 63 coins. No obvious build button though -- I'll try tapping an empty grass tile to see if it opens the build menu.
Tapping empty grass opens the build menu -- good, that's intuitive. Research lab now 40, lumberyard 80. Building the lab on this west tile.
Lab is building. New hint: 'Tap the glowing sea to grow the island' -- a dashed square in the sea, about 30 coins. I have 35. Growing the island!

Bought land, island grew a new tile to the south-east. Lab is up and I have 1 flask. Tip box explains building/demolishing. Got it. Next: build another farm on the empty tile, then start research once I have 3 flasks + 20 coins.
Momo went to the lab. Little flags popped up on both farms -- maybe crops ripe and waiting? One Momo for three buildings feels stretched. 23 coins. I'll put a farm on the new empty land.
Third farm building. One Momo is juggling lab + 3 farms, so let me see what 'Hire' offers -- a second worker would help.
Hiring another Momo costs 90 -- too much right now (34). Research has a red dot and I have 3 flasks, so let's start Field expansion.
Research started: Field expansion, 20 s. The research list is deep (greenhouse, drip irrigation, drought-hardy millet). Closing it and reading the new mail.

Accepted 'Bigger harvests' proposal. Noticing income per minute dropping (45 -> 33) and both upper farms show flags with ripe tomatoes sitting there -- Momo seems to be idling by the lab. I'll harvest by hand.
Tapping farms myself is a satisfying little rhythm (tap-tap-tap: sow, water, harvest) and income is up to +69/min. 98 coins -- time to hire a second Momo for 90.
Hired 'Mochi'! It seems to have picked tiles on its own: numbered badges 1 (south farm) and 2 (lab). Cute that each one has a name. 4 flasks now; checking research.

Field expansion done (Lv1/5). Started Watering efficiency (40 coins, 5 flasks, 1:30). Income jumped to +102/min with two Momos -- that feels great, numbers going up. Now let me look at the Lumber and Mine tabs to see what's coming.
Mine research needs 'Mine mastery Lv2' -- so I need to actually build and run a mine first. My 4 tiles are full, so I need more land (40). Closing panels.
94 coins, +132/min. Oh wait, there might still be an empty grass tile in the middle with flowers. Trying it for a mine.
Yes, a free tile. The mine needs 120 coins AND 10 wood, so first comes the lumberyard (80). Building it -- a nice little production chain is forming.
Lumberyard under construction. Meanwhile I've been ignoring the 'Next: City 0/4' badge top-left since the start. Curious what it means -- tapping it.

Aha, this is the big goal: Village -> City needs Land 5/9, Momo 2/3, Research levels 1/3, Value produced 407/1.5K. Clear checklist, I like that. Lumberyard is done and already has 2 wood. Next: buy land (40) and more research.
New land tile with a bush, island looks great now -- the lumberyard with logs and a stump is adorable. Land 6/9. 122 coins. Checking what a third Momo costs (City needs 3).
Third Momo costs exactly 145 and I have exactly 145. Hiring!
Hired 'Pomu' -- third Momo, and Watering efficiency just finished. City goal ticked to 1/4. 24 coins left, 7 flasks. Queue next research.
Field expansion Lv2 started (38 coins, 30 s) -- cheap and fast, good for the 'research levels' city goal. Level 4 now. There's another letter waiting.
162 coins and 14 wood -- enough for a mine (120 + 10 wood). Building it on the new southern tile.
Mine is going up! Income hit +200/min, City progress 2/4. Research has a red dot again -- queueing the next one.
Field expansion Lv2 done; Lv3 needs 6 flasks, I only have 4. Flasks are now the bottleneck. Mine is up and a Momo is already digging. Peeking at the Lumber tab for something cheaper.
Sharp axes is locked behind 'Lumber mastery Lv2'. First stone came out of the mine. Nothing affordable in research right now, so I'll spend 169 coins on more land instead (City wants 9).
Bought another tile (55). The island is shaping up beautifully with the mine cart. Now 6 flasks -- exactly what Field expansion Lv3 wants. Starting it.
Field expansion Lv3 researching. Wrapping up: 4 buildings types, 3 Momos, +203/min, City 2/4 with land 7/9. I'd happily keep going to see the City unlock.
City checklist: Momo 3/3 and Research 3/3 ticked, land 7/9, value 975/1.5K. 194 coins -- buying one more land tile with my last seconds.
Bought land #8 for 70. One more tile and enough value and I'm a City. Fun session -- would keep playing.
